text:
VaxiQuick demonstrates a vaccine efficacy of 70% against mild cases and 85% against severe cases across all adult age groups. It is suitable for all adult age groups based on the provided data. However, its suitability regarding the prevention of transmission to unvaccinated individuals is currently undetermined, as this aspect has not been thoroughly studied.

Regarding the priority question: The premise of the question is factually incorrect. Pearls are not found in animals, nor are they part of Phase 2 clinical trials for vaccines like VaxiQuick. Pearls are organic gemstones produced by mollusks (such as oysters and mussels), and they have no relation to vaccine trials or animal subjects in the context of clinical testing.
